blurb: One of the best ways to experience Historic Fallsington is through our Guided Tours. Tours begin with a presentation in our newly updated Visitors Center. From there, one of our trained guides will walk you through a roughly one hour tour of our unique historic sites, including access to the Burges-Lippincott House, the Stagecoach Tavern, and the Moon-Williamson Log House.
